bio: The two Ks refer to Kagy (Samantha, chef) and Kinoshita (Kimiko, pastry chef), a pair who joined forces after rewarding stints in prestigious establishments (Violon d'Ingres, L'Ours, Atelier Joël Robuchon, Taillevent). Their consummate technical skill shines through in dishes that are as delicious as their names are enticing, in particular the house signature of roasted pigeon, smoked eel and shallots in a salmis sauce. A few nods to Southwest France are a reminder of the influence of Christian Constant....
